entities.name: Justinus Darmojuwono
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Justinus Darmojuwono was an Indonesian cardinal of the Roman Catholic Church. He served as Archbishop of Semarang from 1963 to 1981 and was elevated to the rank of cardinal in 1967, becoming the first Indonesian to be a cardinal.
